suite: the model drawn alone and led (the end-stop model's parts only, a leader per placed node)
expect_red: [real] a real mouse down and up on a body's field border on the DAG selects the body -- the up and the click land on the field, not on the pane the pan captures for -- and it lights as the tree's row click did

mutations.contract: A body's field is a control, not pan space: the DAG's drag-to-pan never starts on it, so no pointer capture retargets its click.
mutations.note: Review of 2026-11-13, blocker B2: the pan counted a body field as empty space and took pointer capture on pointerdown, so the mouseup and the click landed on the scroll section and the field's onclick never ran. Measured with a real pointer; a dispatched click could not see it. The mutation makes the field pan space again.
